issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a serious possibility of persecution on a Convention ground (section 96)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant alleges marriage to an MLC member who campaigned for human rights and was sought by soldiers at her home in 2010.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not discharge her burden of showing a serious possibility of persecution on a Convention ground.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces personal risk of torture, risk to life or cruel treatment if returned (section 97)
issues.applicant_position: Relies on the same allegations: marriage to an MLC member and soldiers seeking her in 2010.
issues.result_text: Claimant is neither a Convention refugee nor a person in need of protection under section 97(1).
